component.name: Tether
component.summary: Neurodivergent Flowmodoro and cognitive anchoring companion for developers

description.p: Tether is an unbreakable Flowmodoro and cognitive anchoring companion designed specifically for neurodivergent developers (ADHD, Autism, Dyslexia, and AuDHD). It calculates proportional breaks based on your actual focus time without disrupting monotropic flow, parks sudden rabbit-hole thoughts into RAM-dumps and impulse checklists without breaking fragile working memory, anchors your code context for instant recovery, and seamlessly synchronizes with Neovim and VS Code.
Feature release with focus soundscapes, volume popover, interactive checkboxes, retention cleanup, and platform-agnostic focus tracking.

ul.li: Procedural offline focus soundscapes (Brown noise, Pink noise, Gentle rain) with auto-play and fade-down.
Interactive in-row sound controls with play/pause toggle and flush-right volume popover.
Interactive markdown checkboxes for captured impulses with customizable retention pruning.
Platform-agnostic editor focus synchronization across Neovim, VS Code, and desktop.
Dynamic content-driven window sizing without vertical scrolling on the Flow tab.
Gentle focus chime and break gong notifications.

description.p: Added pause banking on early break termination, per-editor minimize settings, and auto-maximize on break.
Initial release of Tether desktop companion.
